master_transform: ImageMagick Lanczos export to 256x256 RGBA; metadata stripped. Generated original SHA-256 retained per icon.

icons.prompt: One original desktop icon for the Yonder XP family, closely inspired by Windows XP Luna's colorful early-2000s icons. A miniature computer application window: royal-blue title bar, cream content panel, three colored simple squares in the content area, crisp blue beveled outer frame. No readable text. Match an approved golden-yellow folder with warm glossy highlights: crisp shaded edges, gentle dimensional bevels, saturated friendly colors, upper-left lighting, simple substantial shapes legible at 16 and 32 pixels. Slight three-quarter perspective where appropriate. Not modern flat, not emoji, not photorealistic. One centered icon occupying about 80% of a square canvas. Transparent background, no surrounding interface, no words, no branding, no large ground shadow.
